d:
United Tigers put on a power-packed show to register a 25-run victory!
Batting first, United Tigers posted a massive 126/6 in 10 overs, powered by a brilliant unbeaten 48 off just 19 balls from Azmatullah Omarzai.
In reply, UAE Bulls managed 101/4, despite Khawaja Nafay's unbeaten 48 off 25 balls, as United Tigers sealed a convincing win.
